plugins.name: jahns-workflow
plugins.description: SSOT-anchored agentic development workflow harness: one-click project setup, a structured task-registry CLI (read/mutate/archive without slurping the file) with a global naming convention, zero-token roadmap rendering, round closeout, a per-round markdown review request for an external reviewer that reads the repo over git, and verbatim review ingestion (plus an optional SHA-bound PR review-cycle merge gate).

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Personal fork of openai/codex-plugin-cc with OS-level sandbox enforcement removed and replaced with prompt-level self-enforcement, for environments where bubblewrap cannot run (cloud containers, GPU hosts, kernels without unprivileged user/network namespace permission).

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Autonomous LLM-research loop adapted from Karpathy's autoresearch for real ML codebases (editable-install Python projects, accelerate / torchrun launchers, wandb metrics). Two skills — setup and run — plus an ar helper CLI that owns launch orchestration, wandb binding, atomic checkpoint commit, process-tree-aware timeout, and chain-mode transitions, so the main Claude session stays context-light across hundreds–thousands of iterations.
